items.name: Royal Crown
items.desc: A royal crown with glittering gems.

items.name: Frost Crown
items.desc: Carved from ice that never melts. Snowflakes drift off it.

items.name: Emerald Crown
items.desc: A emerald crown with glittering gems.

items.name: Void Crown
items.desc: Worn by whoever rules the End. Three void orbs circle it.

items.name: Angel Halo
items.desc: A golden halo that hums with light.

items.name: Demon Halo
items.desc: Burning red, with two little horns to match.

items.name: Cyber Halo
items.desc: Two counter-spinning rings and six orbiting data bits.

items.name: Prism Halo
items.desc: Every colour at once, all the time.

items.name: Gentleman's Top Hat
items.desc: Tall, black and very polite.

items.name: Magician's Hat
items.desc: A rabbit keeps popping out of the top.

items.name: Steampunk Topper
items.desc: Brass gears turn on its side and the goggles glow.

items.name: Arcane Wizard Hat
items.desc: Stars twinkle across it and the tip glows with magic.

items.name: Starlight Wizard Hat
items.desc: Deep blue, sprinkled with starlight.

items.name: Ember Wizard Hat
items.desc: Smoulders at the tip.

items.name: Demon Horns
items.desc: Curved and wicked, with glowing tips.

items.name: Ram Horns
items.desc: Big curled horns for headbutting.

items.name: Dragon Horns
items.desc: Swept back like a dragon's, with a glowing core.

items.name: Unicorn Horn
items.desc: A rainbow horn that sheds sparkles everywhere.

items.name: Cat Ears
items.desc: They twitch when you least expect it.

items.name: Bunny Ears
items.desc: Long and floppy; they bounce as you walk.

items.name: Fox Ears
items.desc: Orange, fluffy, with white tufts.

items.name: Bear Ears
items.desc: Round and cuddly.

items.name: Nimbus Cloud
items.desc: Your own little cloud. It rains when it feels like it.

items.name: Storm Cloud
items.desc: Dark, grumbly, and it throws lightning.

items.name: Mini Sun
items.desc: A tiny star of your own, rays spinning around it.

items.name: Tiny Planet
items.desc: Ringed, with its own moon.

items.name: Floating Crystal
items.desc: A glowing crystal with shards orbiting it.

items.name: Lucky Block
items.desc: It bounces and spins. What's inside? Nobody knows.

items.name: Floating Heart
items.desc: It beats. With love.

items.name: Fire Orb
items.desc: A living flame that follows your head around.

items.name: Black Hole
items.desc: Nothing escapes. Not even your hat hair.

items.name: Nimbus Emblem
items.desc: The Nimbus block and its halo, spinning above you.

items.name: Viking Helmet
items.desc: Steel, brass and two proud horns.

items.name: Propeller Cap
items.desc: The propeller spins so fast it blurs.

items.name: Chef's Hat
items.desc: Puffy, spotless, and ready to cook.

items.name: Pirate Tricorn
items.desc: Skull and crossbones, with a feather that flutters.

items.name: Cowboy Hat
items.desc: Yeehaw. A proper curved brim and a leather band.

items.name: Samurai Kabuto
items.desc: Lacquered black steel with a golden crest that shines.

items.name: Party Hat
items.desc: Striped, sparkly, and it throws confetti.

items.name: Santa Hat
items.desc: Jolly, red, with a bobble that swings.

items.name: Beat Headphones
items.desc: The equaliser bars dance to music only you can hear.

items.name: Alien Antennae
items.desc: Receiving signals from the mothership.

items.name: Flower Crown
items.desc: Fresh blossoms, trailing cherry petals.

items.name: Cosy Beanie
items.desc: Warm, knitted, with a bouncy pom.

items.name: Graduation Cap
items.desc: Top of the class. The tassel never stops swinging.

items.name: Mushroom Cap
items.desc: Totally not poisonous. Probably.

items.name: Little Sprout
items.desc: Water daily. It sways in the breeze.

items.name: Miner Helmet
items.desc: For diamond hunters. The lamp really glows.

items.name: Floating Diamond
items.desc: A diamond that spins over your head. Show off your finds.

items.name: Astronaut Helmet
items.desc: One small step. Its antenna blinks red.

items.name: Jester Hat
items.desc: Jingle jingle. Three floppy tips, three golden bells.

items.name: Ender Eye Halo
items.desc: Six eyes of ender that never stop watching.

items.name: Magma Crown
items.desc: Forged in the Nether. It drips glowing lava.

items.name: UFO Abduction
items.desc: They came for your brain. The beam is just for show.

items.name: Snow Globe
items.desc: A tiny winter inside a glass dome. It never stops snowing.

items.name: Frog Hat
items.desc: Ribbit. It blinks at whoever is behind you.

items.name: Galaxy Crown
items.desc: A crown with its own solar system. The planets never stop.

items.name: Ember Dragon
items.desc: A baby dragon that breathes real (tiny) fire.

items.name: Frost Dragon
items.desc: Its breath is a flurry of snow.

items.name: Void Dragon
items.desc: Born in the End. Breathes pure void energy.

items.name: Golden Dragon
items.desc: Hoards nothing but attention.

items.name: Friendly Ghost
items.desc: Boo! It fades in and out as it floats along.

items.name: Pumpkin Spirit
items.desc: A jack-o'-lantern with a flickering grin.

items.name: Spirit Wisp
items.desc: A little ball of light that leaves a glowing trail.

items.name: Busy Bee
items.desc: Buzz buzz. Its wings are a blur.

items.name: Morpho Butterfly
items.desc: Shimmering blue wings, flapping lazily.

items.name: Monarch Butterfly
items.desc: Orange and black, like a stained-glass window.

items.name: Pixie Fairy
items.desc: A tiny fairy that sheds glowing dust.

items.name: Firefly Swarm
items.desc: Seven fireflies that dance around each other.

items.name: Bouncy Slime
items.desc: Boing. It never stops bouncing.

items.name: Magma Cube
items.desc: Hot, bouncy, and dripping embers.

items.name: Jelly Cube
items.desc: Wobbly, see-through, and colour-changing.

items.name: Axolotl
items.desc: Pink, smiling, and swimming through the air.

items.name: Goldfish in a Bowl
items.desc: A goldfish that brought its own water.

items.name: Moon Jelly
items.desc: A glowing jellyfish drifting through the air.

items.name: Phoenix
items.desc: Reborn from its own flames, over and over.

items.name: Wise Owl
items.desc: Its head turns all the way around. Hoo.

items.name: Night Bat
items.desc: Flaps like crazy and never sits still.

items.name: Rainbow Parrot
items.desc: Every feather cycles through the rainbow.

items.name: Scout Drone
items.desc: Four whirring rotors and a blinking red eye.

items.name: Tiny UFO
items.desc: Spinning saucer with a tractor beam. Take me to your leader.

items.name: Companion Cube
items.desc: It will never threaten to stab you.

items.name: Watcher Eye
items.desc: It looks around. It sees everything.

items.name: Pocket Satellite
items.desc: Solar panels out, beaming back signal.

items.name: Cloud Cat
items.desc: Curled up on its cloud, tail swishing.

items.name: Cloud Pup
items.desc: A good boy. Its tail never stops wagging.

items.name: Cloud Fox
items.desc: Sly, fluffy, and a little bit magic.

items.name: Cloud Panda
items.desc: Munching bamboo on a cloud.

items.name: Cloud Penguin
items.desc: Waddles in place, very seriously.

items.name: Cloud Frog
items.desc: Ribbit. It hops, and occasionally flips.

items.name: Cloud Turtle
items.desc: Slow and steady, on a very fluffy cloud.

items.name: Cloud Crab
items.desc: Snip snap. It waves its claws at everyone.

items.name: Rubber Duck
items.desc: Squeak. Bobs like it's in the bath.

items.name: Star Buddy
items.desc: A little star that twinkles and trails stardust.

items.name: Pocket Black Hole
items.desc: A black hole on a leash. Try not to fall in.

items.name: Crystal Cluster
items.desc: A living geode, humming with light.

items.name: Nimbus Buddy
items.desc: The Nimbus block itself, following you around.

items.name: Love Bug
items.desc: A heart with a face. It thinks you're great.

items.name: Cloud Chick
items.desc: Fluffy, yellow and very proud of its little hops.

items.name: Cloud Bunny
items.desc: Twitchy nose, floppy ears, endless hopping.

items.name: Cloud Sheep
items.desc: Hard to tell where the sheep ends and the cloud begins.

items.name: Cloud Snail
items.desc: In no hurry at all. Its shell swirls.

items.name: Mini Creeper
items.desc: Tssss... it swells up now and then, but never goes off.

items.name: Allay
items.desc: A little blue spirit that loves music.

items.name: Robo Buddy
items.desc: Beep boop. Its antenna blinks and its eyes scan around.

items.name: Sky Octopus
items.desc: Eight wiggly arms, swimming through the air.

items.name: Sky Shark
items.desc: It swims circles round you. Friendly. Mostly.

items.name: Sky Whale
items.desc: A little whale that swims through the clouds and sprays glitter.

items.name: Pet Comet
items.desc: A tiny comet with a burning tail, circling your shoulder.

items.name: Mini Wither
items.desc: Three little skulls that float, glare and cackle. Scary cute.

items.name: Diamond Golem
items.desc: A tiny golem made of diamond. Proof you really went mining.

items.name: Angel Wings
items.desc: Soft white feathers that shed a little light.

items.name: Demon Wings
items.desc: Leathery bat wings with burning veins.

items.name: Prism Butterfly Wings
items.desc: See-through butterfly wings that shift through every colour.

items.name: Glass Fairy Wings
items.desc: Four delicate glass wings that buzz quickly.

items.name: Dragon Wings
items.desc: Huge scaled wings with glowing membranes.

items.name: Mech Wings
items.desc: Armoured panels with neon light lines, folding in and out.

items.name: Phoenix Wings
items.desc: Wings made of fire, raining embers as they beat.

items.name: Frost Crystal Wings
items.desc: Wings of shattered ice, trailing snowflakes.

items.name: Void Wings
items.desc: Wings cut from the night sky, full of drifting stars.

items.name: Forest Wings
items.desc: Grown from living leaves; a few always drift away.

items.name: Bat Wings
items.desc: Small, leathery and a bit spooky.

items.name: Bee Wings
items.desc: See-through and buzzing so fast they blur.

items.name: Cloud Wings
items.desc: Puffy wings made of cloud. They leave a little mist behind.

items.name: Rainbow Wings
items.desc: Feathers in every colour, rippling like a rainbow.

items.name: Amethyst Wings
items.desc: Shards of amethyst, humming with energy.

items.name: Storm Wings
items.desc: Wings of living lightning. They crackle when you move.

items.name: Paper Plane Wings
items.desc: Folded from the finest paper. Aerodynamic, probably.

items.name: Rune Circle
items.desc: A magic circle turns under your feet, runes glowing.

items.name: Ring of Fire
items.desc: A ring of flames dancing around your feet.

items.name: Blizzard
items.desc: Your own personal snowstorm.

items.name: Orbiting Gems
items.desc: Five precious gems circle you, sparkling.

items.name: Music Notes
items.desc: Notes float around you like you're always humming.

items.name: Nimbus Rings
items.desc: Three halo rings orbit you like the Nimbus logo.

items.name: Heart Swirl
items.desc: Little hearts float round you. Aww.

items.name: Autumn Swirl
items.desc: A breeze of autumn leaves follows you everywhere.

items.name: Bubble Stream
items.desc: Bubbles rise all around you, like you're underwater.

items.name: Star Ring
items.desc: Five stars circle you, twinkling.

items.name: Cherry Blossoms
items.desc: Pink petals drift down around you.

items.name: Static Charge
items.desc: You're so charged up that sparks jump off you.

items.name: Shadow Cloak
items.desc: Dark smoke curls up around you, with red eyes watching.

items.name: Nether Portal
items.desc: A swirl of portal purple spins at your feet.

items.name: Coin Shower
items.desc: Nimbus coins spin round you. Show everyone how rich you are.

items.name: Blade Dance
items.desc: Four diamond swords circle you, ready for anything.

items.name: Galaxy Disc
items.desc: A whole spiral galaxy turns under your feet.
